subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Center, size, and shape can change how people imagine importance.”?
options: The class compared several maps from different years.
After class, several students asked Jenny about the song.
Old maps show how people once understood the world."
The class looked at several world maps and discussed perspective.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The class compared several maps from different years.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After class, several students asked Jenny about the song.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Old maps show how people once understood the world.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Center, size, and shape can change how people imagine importance. The class looked at several world maps and discussed perspective.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
